inline.t: Debt holders

call option

inline.t: The
cash conversion cycle (CCC)
is the number of days cash is tied up between paying suppliers and collecting from customers. A shorter cycle needs less working capital.
CCC = DIO + DSO − DPO · DIO = 365 ÷ inventory turnover (COGS ÷ avg inventory) · DSO = 365 ÷ receivables turnover (sales ÷ avg receivables) · DPO = 365 ÷ payables turnover (purchases ÷ avg payables)
Meera Textiles: DIO 45 days, DSO 30 days, DPO 40 days. CCC = 45 + 30 − 40 =
35 days
. If it negotiates DPO up to 50 days, CCC falls to 25 days and frees cash.
A
negative CCC
is possible: retailers that sell before they pay suppliers are effectively financed by those suppliers.

questions.q: A company that sells printers cheaply and earns its profit on ink cartridges uses:
questions.e: The base product is priced low to lock in recurring purchases of profitable consumables.

questions.q: Freemium pricing means that:
o: A basic version is free and premium features are paid for
Every product is sold at cost
Prices change by time of day
questions.e: Free users are the funnel; revenue comes from those who upgrade.

questions.q: A ride-hailing app that raises fares during peak demand is using:
questions.e: Prices that move with real-time demand are dynamic pricing.

questions.q: A platform business benefits from network effects when:
o: Each additional user makes the service more valuable to other users
Unit costs rise as it grows
It owns all the inventory it sells
questions.e: Network effects mean value per user rises with the number of users.

questions.q: A franchise business model typically involves:
o: The company owning and running every outlet
The franchisor licensing its brand and system to independent operators for fees
questions.e: Franchisees run outlets using the franchisor's brand and processes, paying fees and royalties.

questions.q: A subscription costs ₹499 a month, the variable cost per subscriber is ₹149 a month and customer acquisition cost is ₹2,100. The payback period on acquisition cost is:
questions.e: Monthly contribution = 499 − 149 = 350; 2,100 ÷ 350 = 6 months.

questions.q: An asset-light business model most likely:
o: Owns all its factories and logistics
Requires the highest capital expenditure in its industry
Outsources capital-intensive activities and keeps fixed assets low
questions.e: Asset-light firms focus on brand, design or software and outsource heavy assets.

questions.q: Charging students a lower price than corporate buyers for the same course is an example of:
questions.e: Different prices for different customer groups for the same product is price discrimination.

questions.q: An omnichannel strategy:
o: Uses only a direct sales force
Integrates online and physical channels into one customer experience
questions.e: Omnichannel blends store, web and app so customers can switch between them seamlessly.

flashcards.back: Who, what, where, how, how much.
What the customer will pay vs cost plus a markup.
Cheap base product, profit on consumables (printer and ink).
Each extra user makes the service more valuable to others.
Outsource capital-intensive activities; keep fixed assets low.
Customer acquisition cost ÷ monthly contribution per customer.
